thread:
alex: FYI customer reported 404s right after upgrading our @redwood/sdk TS client from 1.4.2 -> 2.0.0. says endpoint /v1/complete is missing.

linda: Can you paste the exact SDK call and error? which route are they hitting? :eyes:

alex: Minimal repro from customer:
```
// package.json: "@redwood/sdk": "2.0.0"
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.KEY })
await client.complete({ model: 'gpt-small', prompt: 'hi' })
```
Response: 404 Not Found { message: "Route not found: POST /v1/complete" }

alex: They say same code worked with 1.4.2.

tom: v2 landed breaking changes — we renamed some surface area and consolidated endpoints in the API. IIRC client.complete() was replaced. Check changelog.

linda: Can you run a curl against the host they use? might be a routing mismatch between client and control-plane.

alex: curl repro (customer env):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"hi"}'
```
=> 404 with body: `{ "error": "Route not found" }`

emily: Looks like the public API no longer exposes /v1/complete — new endpoint is /v1/generate and payload param 'model' renamed to 'modelName' in v2 client. If client's still calling /v1/complete, it's an old route removed in control plane release.

alex: Customer insists they only upgraded the npm package, not product. They use hosted API. So control plane might have been rolled concurrently with client change.

tom: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-02-11-rc removed legacy /v1/complete route (rolled globally). :warning:

deploy-bot: link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/2026-02-11-rc

alex: Ok that explains 404. But customer also reported that after switching to client.generate({ modelName: ... }) they get 400 invalid param 'modelName' on older Dedicated clusters.

linda: That screams version mismatch between SDK and Dedicated control plane. Need to detect client compatibility and fail fast with clearer error.

emily: Created internal ticket INC-3421 to track compatibility detection + telemetry and a recommended rollback docs snippet: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3421

alex: For immediate customer workaround I told them to pin @redwood/sdk@1.4.2 and restart service. They confirmed that restores behaviour.

tom: Action items:
- eng-runtime: add compatibility header in v2 client (x-redwood-client-version) and server-side 400 with message recommending pin
- product/docs: update migration notes and changelog (v2 -> endpoint mapping)
- support: add KB: "404s after SDK upgrade" with quick pin instructions

linda: Can someone from eng-runtime take INC-3421? assigning to @kevin in the ticket.

infra-bot: NOTE: dedicated clusters on customer org 'acme' are on control plane 1.95 (pre-change). Hosted route removal is global; older Dedicated will continue to accept /v1/complete until they upgrade control plane.

alex: Customer asked if we can re-enable route as emergency. emily: not advisable globally, we'll offer rollback only for small set if policy allows.

emily: Closing loop — customer pinned to 1.4.2, their service is back. Keeping ticket open for compatibility improvements. :white_check_mark:

linda: Thanks team. I'll draft KB and ping eng-runtime for prioritization.
